designVote.proposal: Retain recourse through impairment; discharge only denomination-Cash funded nominal debt; allocate pool impairment and liquidation fee to fixed shares; reverse impairment only against funded recovery; preserve residual duty, exhausted grants and closure reserve.
designVote.rationale: The proposed policy supplies the concrete economic distinctions missing from original R01. Its deliberately assumed recourse and fee policy is coherent, observable and useful as an additional RP01 design challenge.
